question: Who among the following won the Sultan of Johor Cup 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is I__**ndia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India **won** the Sultan of Johor Cup 2022.
 
• They defeated Australia in the final by a score of** 5-4** in a penalty shootout after the match was tied at 1-1 in regulation time.
 
• This was India's third Sultan of Johor Cup title, and they equaled **England **as the most successful team in the tournament's history.
 
• The match was played at the** Taman Daya Hockey Stadium in Johor Bahru**, **Malaysia**, on March 11, 2022.
 
• India took the lead in the first quarter through a goal from **Sudeep Chirmako**.
 
• Australia equalized in the second quarter through **Jack Holland**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The Sultan Johor Cup is a tournament of International under 21 men's field hockey tournament__ held in Malaysia.
 
• It was founded in __2011__, in which five teams have emerged victorious.
 
• Great Britain was the most successful team, who won the tournament three times.
 
• India and Australia won the tournament twice while Germany and Malaysia won the tournament once.
